proposals.evidence: CDIAL 3329 kurkura/kukkura explicitly means dog and gives Nepali kukur and neighboring kukar/kukur forms. The survey kukara/kukuru/kurkur shapes select this k-medial family, not kuttira with medial t. Exact survey form kʊkʊɾu is preserved.
